question: Eight libraries (B104 cold and control, 4 replicates each) are in PRJNA556806 but not in the paper: it describes 21 DH lines x 2 treatments x 4 replicates = 168 libraries (Table S1 lists exactly those). The accession note calls PE0075 and B104 'reference lines', but PE0075 is one of the 21 DH lines in the paper. Keep B104?
proposed_answer: Keep include = TRUE as genotype B104 (other inbred, cold_tolerance NR, cold vs control at 12 vs 18 °C, same design). Do not count it with the 21 DH lines in tolerant/susceptible groupings; confirm with the data owner (Hochholdinger lab) that B104 was grown and treated together with the DH lines.
evidence: BioSample aliases C11, C12, F11, F12, J15, J16, D15, D16 (runs SRR9841917, SRR9841918, SRR9841942, SRR9841959, SRR9841997, SRR9841998, SRR9842058, SRR9842059) are B104; Table S1 (BMC Genomics additional file 2) has 168 samples and no B104; B104 is not mentioned in the text.

item: Light or dark during the 8 h treatment
question: Methods: 10 seedlings per replicate grown 4 d at 26/18 °C (16 h light/8 h dark), then an 8 h treatment at 12 °C (cold) or 18 °C (control). The Discussion calls 12 vs 18 °C the cold vs control 'night temperatures'. Was the 8 h treatment in the dark (the 8 h night) or did it span light?
proposed_answer: Record temperature_C 12 / 18 (treatment temperatures), leave temperature_night_C and light_condition empty because the paper does not say. If the treatment was the night period, 18 °C equals the control night temperature of the growth regime.
evidence: Frey 2020 Methods 'Plant growth and RNA isolation' and Discussion 'Transcriptomic response upon cold treatment'.

question: The main text names only PE0161, PE0002 and PE0328 as the most tolerant lines; the tolerant/susceptible split of the 21 lines (11 tolerant, 10 susceptible) is in Fig. 1 (colours, not readable from text). I took it from the column grouping of Table S3 (Additional file 4: 'Susceptible genotypes' = PE0440 PE0159 PE0026 PE0420 PE0345 PE0334 PE0019 PE0022 PE0349 PE0323; 'Tolerant genotypes' = PE0265 PE0359 PE0075 PE0100 PE0040 PE0485 PE0055 PE0099 PE0002 PE0328 PE0161), which agrees with the 'sum tolerants' and 'sum susceptibles' columns and with the text. Check against Fig. 1b?
proposed_answer: Use the Table S3 grouping (tolerant 11, susceptible 10). Tolerance is the paper's root growth ratio cold/control (a continuous measure; the paper's classes are the two groups).
evidence: Table S3 header row, additional file MOESM4 of doi 10.1186/s12864-020-6682-1; text 'ten cold susceptible ... and eleven cold tolerant DH-lines'.

question: BioSample says 4 days after sowing; Methods say 4 d at control conditions then an 8 h treatment (so about 4.3 d at harvest). Which age to record?
proposed_answer: age_days = 4 (age at treatment start, as in BioSample); stage = 4 days after sowing.
